"""Predeclared reduction of archived support metadata;no causal intervention or forwards."""
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V167-bounded-support-v1'
review=read(root/'review-result-v1.json');cases={c['id']:c for c in read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations']};groups=defaultdict(list);collections={};ADC=[]
for label,binding in review['collections'].items():
 assert ref(binding['path'])==binding;c=read(binding['path']);assert c['module_before']==c['module_after'] and c['RNG_unchanged']
 collections[label]=binding
 for row in c['observations']:
  case=cases[row['id']];condition=case.get('present',case.get('variant',{}).get('name',case.get('noise',{}).get('name')))
  assert 0<=row['support_mean']<=1 and all(np.isfinite(row[k]) for k in ['support_mean','coefficient_correction_RMS','spatial_correction_RMS_DN16'])
  expected_floor=.25 if label.startswith('bounded-support-') else 0.
  assert row['declared_support_floor']==expected_floor and expected_floor<=row['support_minimum']<=row['support_maximum']<=1
  groups[label,case['kind'],condition,case.get('cohort')].append(row)
  if case['kind']=='photo' and case.get('cohort')=='adc-photo256':
   assert ref(row['prediction']['path'])==row['prediction'] and ref(case['parent']['path'])==case['parent']
   equal=np.array_equal(np.load(row['prediction']['path']),np.load(case['parent']['path']))
   ADC.append({'method':label,'id':case['id'],'exact_parent':equal})
summary=[]
for (label,kind,condition,cohort),rows in groups.items():
 values=np.asarray([v['support_mean'] for v in rows]);summary.append({'method':label,'kind':kind,'condition':condition,'cohort':cohort,'cases':len(rows),
  'support_mean_min_median_p90_max':np.quantile(values,[0,.5,.9,1]).tolist(),'cases_support_mean_below_1e4':int((values<1e-4).sum()),
  'declared_support_floor':rows[0]['declared_support_floor'],'minimum_support_over_cases':min(v['support_minimum'] for v in rows),
  'maximum_support_over_cases':max(v['support_maximum'] for v in rows),'cases_mean_within_1e4_of_floor':int((values<rows[0]['declared_support_floor']+1e-4).sum()),
  'mean_coefficient_correction_RMS':float(np.mean([v['coefficient_correction_RMS'] for v in rows])),
  'mean_spatial_correction_RMS_DN16':float(np.mean([v['spatial_correction_RMS_DN16'] for v in rows]))})
output=repo/'docs/results/v167-archived-support-summary-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'completed-predeclared-archived-metadata-reduction-and-ADC-parent-check','collections':collections,
 'design':ref(root/'quality-design-v1.json'),'rows_checked':3288,'groups':summary,'ADC_photo_parent_checks':ADC,
 'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'new_neural_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
 'scope':'Predeclared diagnostic of support and direct RGB activity. This reduction was frozen before final quality existed. Summarizes scalar mean support and pre-support coefficient/spatial correction RMS already recorded during original actual forwards. Full support maps were not retained,so no independent pixel-level gate reconstruction is claimed. Recorded min/max verifies configured support bound on every original forward. Support values and coefficient RMS do not establish delivered correction or quality;full maps were not retained. ADC exact-parent checks use actual original arrays. No model,weights,loss or inference changed.'})
for g in summary:
 if g['kind']=='mesh' and g['condition'] is True:print(g)
print('ADC-photo exact parent',[(m,sum(v['exact_parent'] for v in ADC if v['method']==m),sum(v['method']==m for v in ADC)) for m in collections])
